modules.name: id_stage
modules.description: Owns IF/ID pipeline register (valid, pc, pc+4, instr). Decodes RV32I subset, generates immediates and all control fields, drives register-file read addresses, detects ECALL and rs1/rs2 usage for the hazard unit. flush clears IF/ID valid, stall holds IF/ID, halt freezes it.

modules.name: ex_stage
modules.description: Owns ID/EX pipeline register. Applies EX operand forwarding (fwd_a/fwd_b), ALU, branch compare and target, JAL/JALR target/link, store data. Emits ex_redirect/ex_redirect_pc and EX/MEM payload (ex_*). flush clears ID/EX valid (bubble). Also exports registered source addresses id_ex_rs1_addr/id_ex_rs2_addr for the forwarding unit.

modules.name: mem_stage
modules.description: Owns EX/MEM pipeline register. Drives data-memory request (dmem_valid/we/addr/wdata/be) from EX/MEM fields, masked combinationally by rst_n and ~halt; performs load byte/half/word selection and sign/zero extension. Exports registered EX/MEM fields for forwarding (ex_mem_*) and MEM/WB payload (mem_*).

modules.name: wb_stage
modules.description: Owns MEM/WB pipeline register. Produces register-file write port (wb_we, wb_rd, wb_wdata) gated by rd!=0 and ~halted; commits ECALL at the WB clock edge by setting halted=1 and latching exit_code from x10_value. Once halted, MEM/WB holds and all outputs stay stable.

modules.name: hazard_unit
modules.description: Load-use stall detection and control-hazard flush generation, plus ECALL halt-pending state. Priority: redirect > ECALL halt-pending > load-use stall > PC+4. Emits stall_pc (freeze PC and IF/ID), flush_if_id (clear IF/ID valid) and flush_id_ex (clear ID/EX valid).

modules.name: forwarding_unit
modules.description: Combinational EX operand forwarding select. Priority EX/MEM over MEM/WB; skips rd==0, invalid or non-writing sources, and never forwards an EX/MEM load result. fwd encoding: 2'b00 = ID/EX register value, 2'b01 = EX/MEM alu result, 2'b10 = MEM/WB writeback data.

modules.name: regfile
modules.description: 32x32 architectural register file with two combinational read ports (write-first bypass from WB), one synchronous WB write port, a combinational debug read port, and a combinationally exported x10 for exit_code capture. x0 is hardwired to zero.
modules.interfaces: clk: input logic; rst_n: input logic; wb_we: input logic; wb_rd: input logic [4:0]; wb_wdata: input logic [31:0]; rs1_addr: input logic [4:0]; rs1_data: output logic [31:0]; rs2_addr: input logic [4:0]; rs2_data: output logic [31:0]; dbg_addr: input logic [4:0]; dbg_data: output logic [31:0]; x10_value: output logic [31:0]

notes: Pipeline registers live inside stages: if_stage owns PC; id_stage owns IF/ID; ex_stage owns ID/EX; mem_stage owns EX/MEM; wb_stage owns MEM/WB. Stage-to-stage nets: id_* (ID->EX inputs), ex_* (EX->MEM inputs), mem_* (MEM->WB inputs); registered copies are ex_mem_* (EX/MEM, exported by mem_stage for forwarding) and mem_wb_* (exported by wb_stage). Control encodings frozen: id_alu_op 0=ADD,1=SUB,2=SLL,3=SLT,4=SLTU,5=XOR,6=SRL,7=SRA,8=OR,9=AND,10=PASS_B(LUI); id_alu_a_sel 0=rs1,1=pc; id_alu_b_sel 0=rs2,1=imm; id_br_op 0=BEQ,1=BNE,2=BLT,3=BGE,4=BLTU,5=BGEU; id_mem_to_reg 0=alu result (also LUI/AUIPC/JAL/JALR, whose link value is forced into ex_alu_result), 1=load data; fwd 2'b00 none, 2'b01 EX/MEM, 2'b10 MEM/WB. EX forces ex_alu_result=pc_plus4 for JAL/JALR so forwarding from EX/MEM is never wrong. Store rs2 dependency is handled by the load-use stall (spec 7.3 permits stalling instead of MEM store-data forwarding), so no MEM-stage store-data mux is implemented. Hazard priority: ex_redirect (flush_if_id+flush_id_ex, PC<=redirect_pc) > ECALL halt-pending (stall_pc+flush_if_id only, ECALL keeps flowing) > load-use (stall_pc + flush_id_ex) > PC+4. halt_pending is set by id_valid&id_is_ecall&~ex_redirect and clears only on reset; halted is produced in wb_stage and fed back as halt to if/id/ex/mem to freeze state after commit; dmem_valid is combinationally masked by rst_n and ~halted inside mem_stage and again at top level.
